title: Solver-portfolio promotion contract (L23)
description: Top-N weighted solver portfolio for hedged correctness. See ADR-048.

invariants.name: acc_pass_per_member
invariants.description: Each portfolio member passes ADR-034 anti-cargo-cult.
must: ACC gate applied PER member at promotion time
weak members rejected before being included

invariants.name: unanimous_for_high_risk
must: weighted majority NOT applied at high_risk

invariants.name: weighted_majority_for_routine_standard
must: weighted vote based on SPP-002 weights

invariants.name: member_replaceable
must: no need to re-run anti-cargo-cult on remaining

invariants.name: portfolio_audit_trail
invariants.description: Dispatch logs member solver_ids + individual answers + aggregate.
must: events.jsonl entry includes portfolio.members + portfolio.answers + portfolio.aggregate
operator can audit weighted vote retroactively
